_key.description: Ensembl gene ID and Ensembl transcript ID joined by an underscore, for example ENSG00000290825_ENST00000456328.

_from.description: Document handle of the gene, for example genes/ENSG00000290825.

_to.description: Document handle of a transcript of that gene, for example transcripts/ENST00000456328.

source.description: The dataset this edge was loaded from.

version.description: GENCODE release the annotation was taken from.

source_url.description: Link to the GENCODE annotation file this edge was derived from.

name.description: Predicate describing the relationship in the _from to _to direction: the gene transcribes this transcript.

inverse_name.description: Predicate describing the same relationship in the _to to _from direction: the transcript is transcribed by this gene.

biological_process.description: Gene Ontology term for the process this edge represents, as a handle into ontology_terms. GO_0010467 is 'gene expression'.
